question: The Uttarakhand Public Services (Horizontal Reservation for Women) Bill, 2022 provides how much reservation to women?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Uttarakhand Public Services (Horizontal Reservation for Women) Bill, 2022** aims to provide **30% horizontal reservation** to women of Uttarakhand in government jobs.
 
• This reservation is applicable to **women who are domiciled in Uttarakhand**.
